transient_control.method: Stereo-linked60ms lookahead minimum hold,6ms Gaussian gain smoothing; no hard clipping

sections.name: question
sections.rationale: Low A-C-E with dotted/eighth/held identity; cautious response and genuine rests.

sections.name: question_variation
sections.rationale: A changed return lifts the third note and leaves a different suspended ending.

sections.name: answer_fragment
sections.rationale: C-B-A answer turns through F/E uncertainty instead of closing the story.

sections.name: return_open
sections.rationale: The question returns softly; B/E continue naturally into the next loop.
